nodes.label: Feature: QR code and manual address connect
Feature: Import from iPhone by cable
GalleryPickerScreen (photo grid)
nodes.rationale: Permissions are asked when the grid opens, never at launch, with mediaLocation (D-037); grid returns only ids/kinds/Live flags, no bytes.

nodes.label: Limited photo access handling
nodes.rationale: iOS Limited and Android 14 selected photos show a banner with Select more and Settings; iOS automatic limited prompt disabled.

nodes.label: Preparer (prepare picks before offer)
nodes.rationale: Runs on Send after the receiver is checked so its platform is known for format rules; iOS exports originals, Android reads in place.

nodes.label: iOS ExportChannel (crossdrop/export)
nodes.rationale: Reads the original resource via PHAssetResourceManager chunk by chunk into staging; 90 s without progress counts as iCloud failure.

nodes.label: Android SourceChannel (crossdrop/source)
nodes.rationale: Opens MediaStore content URIs as descriptors with setRequireOriginal; nothing is copied.

nodes.label: SourceOpener
nodes.rationale: Opens each source once per file and closes it after, so 10,000 files never hold 10,000 descriptors.

nodes.label: Staging folder cleanup
nodes.rationale: Staged batches and SAF grants kept while a send can still resume; orphan batches deleted at launch.

nodes.label: OnboardingGate
nodes.rationale: Shows Home if the database cannot be read rather than locking the user out.

nodes.label: receiveAllowedProvider (D-050)
nodes.rationale: Receiving starts only after onboarding so the iOS Local Network prompt follows the page that explains it.

nodes.label: Just-in-time permission prompts
nodes.rationale: Every permission is asked at the moment it is needed, not on the onboarding pages.

nodes.label: Pinned TLS 1.3 (pinnedHttpClient)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the Phase 1 accept-any-certificate client; wrong certificate fails in the handshake.

nodes.label: Sender authentication by signed challenge
nodes.rationale: dart:io cannot do mutual TLS with unknown certificates (D-027), so the sender proves its key with commit, challenge, sign, token.

nodes.label: crossdrop-commit-v2 commitment (D-061)
nodes.rationale: Binds pinned receiver fingerprint, sender fingerprint and nonce to stop man-in-the-middle relaying.

nodes.label: 6-digit pairing code (derivePairingCode)
nodes.rationale: Shown on both phones for untrusted senders; nonces included in the code (D-029).

nodes.label: Bearer token on /v1/sessions requests
nodes.rationale: Secret inside the pinned TLS stream; never logged or stored; 401 auth_required triggers one re-auth.

nodes.label: Session ownership by sender fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Requests for a session owned by another fingerprint get 404 as if it did not exist.

nodes.label: QR connect payload (crossdrop://connect)
nodes.rationale: Carries ip, port, fp, id, n; unknown params ignored so later hotspot params will not break older apps.

nodes.label: ConnectPayload strict parse
nodes.rationale: Refuses hostile codes: look-alike hosts, non-local IPs, bad escapes; error messages never include the payload.

nodes.label: pickQrAddress (network_monitor)
nodes.rationale: Prefers Wi-Fi client interface, then hotspot, never mobile data or VPN.

nodes.label: Manual IP and port entry
nodes.rationale: No expected id, so any CrossDrop device at the address is accepted; Phase 4 requires the 6-digit code.

nodes.label: Receiver checkpoint (.part fsync then receivedBytes)
nodes.rationale: Every 2 s or 64 MB (D-065); after a crash the part is cut back to the checkpoint since later bytes may not be on disk (D-022); parts live in app support not temp (D-025).

nodes.label: locatePeer (find receiver by device id)
nodes.rationale: After the third failed attempt the sender looks up the receiver by id over mDNS, following a restart on a new random port.

nodes.label: BackgroundFileHash (hashing without re-reading, D-021)
nodes.rationale: Sender hashes in its own isolate in parallel; receiver keeps incremental hash alive across drops so resuming 2 GB does not re-hash 1.5 GB.

nodes.label: saveCollectionFor
nodes.rationale: Chosen from the sanitized name's extension; declared MIME type never used, declared kind only if it matches.

nodes.label: MediaStoreFileStore (Android, crossdrop/save)
nodes.rationale: Writes arriving bytes straight into a pending MediaStore item, so nothing is copied; refused MIME goes to Downloads.

nodes.label: IosPhotosSaver (crossdrop/photos)
nodes.rationale: Moves the verified file into Photos with shouldMoveFile and add-only access asked at Accept (D-043).

nodes.label: Convert HEIC to JPEG / Send Live Photo videos (D-039)
nodes.rationale: Both off by default: originals, still only.

nodes.label: Device name setting (TXT n)
nodes.rationale: At most 63 UTF-8 bytes; rename waits while a transfer is in flight.

nodes.label: lib/app/version.dart
nodes.rationale: A test keeps it equal to pubspec.yaml so no package is needed.

nodes.label: Android ShareChannel (singleTask MainActivity)
nodes.rationale: singleTask so a share reaches the running instance; only other apps' content:// URIs accepted so CrossDrop cannot be made to send its private files.

nodes.label: App Group inbox hand-off (manifest.json)
nodes.rationale: Manifest written last and atomically; inbox taken only after launch cleanup, which keeps staging folders changed in last 10 minutes (review H4).

nodes.label: parseShareManifest
nodes.rationale: Version 1, at most 10,000 items, relative paths inside the share, regular files only.

nodes.label: SendSession (sender queue)
nodes.rationale: The offer is never retried automatically, since a lost reply could leave a duplicate offer.

nodes.label: Accept prompt (60 s timeout)
nodes.rationale: Sender waits 75 s, longer than the receiver's 60 s, and polls GET every 2 s so a broken WebSocket never hides the answer.

nodes.label: Too many bytes fails the file
nodes.rationale: A sender that sends more than declared is broken or hostile; resuming would not help, so that file fails and others continue.

nodes.label: Free space check (offer + open sessions + 64 MB)
SHA-256 verification at complete
nodes.rationale: hash_mismatch with retry restarts from zero once; second mismatch fails the file.

nodes.label: ReceiveHost: Home is the receive screen (D-046)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the receive controller alive above the navigator; server stops 30 s after hidden and idle.

nodes.label: TransferView: one view model for both directions (D-048)
nodes.rationale: ProgressView and ResultView take it as plain widgets so they test without the engine.

nodes.label: Accessibility rules (48 dp, WCAG AA, 2x text)
Files first, then the phone (D-052)
nodes.rationale: Sizes of photos and videos are known only after preparing, so Send shows 'at least' until then.

nodes.label: UsbCameraChannel (crossdrop/usb_camera)
nodes.rationale: Walks folders newest first in pages of 500 so the grid is usable while the rest loads.

nodes.label: buildCameraRoll (Live/edited grouping)
nodes.rationale: Groups by folder and name, strips the E of edited copies; unpaired files become their own tile so no photo is hidden.

nodes.label: ImportRunner (copy queue)
nodes.rationale: Never asks for more bytes than declared, then probes one byte past the end; size_mismatch deletes the item.

nodes.label: PTP over USB via android.mtp.MtpDevice
nodes.rationale: Cable is a direct link and iPhone asks the user to allow access, so no network or TLS; iPhone needs no app (D-067).
